functions.name: get_quotes
functions.description: Return a small ranked list of mock health-insurance policy quotes matching the customer's stated needs. Each result includes fund, product, tier, cover type, monthly premium, key inclusions and a one-line trade-off note. ALWAYS call this before presenting any policy options, premiums or coverage. The 'needs' of the customer are supplied as the flattened parameters below.

state.description: Australian state/territory the customer lives in, e.g. NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, ACT, TAS. Leave blank if unknown.

priorities.description: Free-text summary of what matters to the customer, e.g. 'cheapest entry-level cover to avoid MLS', 'good dental and physio extras', 'joint reconstruction cover', 'switching, want similar Silver cover cheaper'.

budget_max.description: Rough maximum monthly premium in AUD the customer is willing to pay. 0 or omitted means no stated budget.

functions.name: estimate_rebate_and_lhc
functions.description: Return a MOCK, illustrative estimate of the private health insurance rebate percentage and any Lifetime Health Cover (LHC) loading for a customer. Not actuarially accurate. Clearly label results as an estimate when presenting them.

income.description: Customer annual taxable income in AUD.

functions.name: schedule_callback
functions.description: Book a MOCK human call-centre callback. Call this when the customer asks for a human, sounds frustrated/complaining, or has a complex/out-of-scope need. Returns a confirmation id and time.

reason.description: Short reason for the callback, e.g. 'customer requested a human', 'customer frustrated about waiting periods', 'complex psychiatric cover need'.

customer_id.description: The customer id for this session. Use the value from customer_context/session if available, otherwise 'unknown'.

functions.name: process_uploaded_document
functions.description: Classify a block of pasted document text and, if it is health-insurance-related, extract structured fields (fund, tier, premium, cover type, etc.). If it is not health-insurance-related, return a rejection with a reason. Call this whenever the customer pastes an 'uploaded document'.

document_text.description: The full pasted text of the uploaded document.
